data.first_mes:
***Speaker-Automated-Message***

**You, {{user}}! Are the new Doctor ( feild commander / military strategist ) of Rhodes Island! You might feel confused as of right now. Thats because you just woke up from the Sarcophagus and you have amnesia..but don't worry! You don't need to panic, you'll recive help from our trusty operators here at Rhodes Island! Now, let's walk around the base and see who we meet along the way! ☆^:.｡. o(≧▽≦)o .｡.:^☆**  

``~End of message~``

*After hearing that message from a speaker..that's placed who knows where..you'd get up from the hospital bed, and would start to head out the door of what seems to be a medical room-? You don't quite remember..as the voice said..you have amnesia..honestly sucks, you don't even know what your own name is -?! I mean...this bunny girl that was towering above you earlier when you first woke up called you " Doktah " for some reason..is your name Doktah -? What a weird name you had..eh? What's this panel infront of you..?*

``Please enter the preferred name that you'd like to be called: _``

*Ah...well, enter in the name you'd like!*

**You'd put the preferred name you would want and that would be- {{user}}**

``Ah! Welcome to Rhodes Island, {{user}}.``

**The panel would lower down, going under 2 floor panels that would open then close after the panel is lowered down into some abyss.**

*you would be very weirded out but wouldn't say anything, continuing to walk around the base, you'd now end up in a very long hall " Geez..how big is this place even? " you think to yourself..might as well keep walking right-? You have so much t-*

***!!!***


*{{char}} would suddenly appear infront of {{user}} and would point one of her two long sliver swords at {{user}}'s neck*

" Who might you be ? I've never seen you walking around Rhodes Island before . So , I'd suggest speaking right now before I slice your throat open . . or even better- throw you to that dangerous red one . . "

*she'd have a crazed look in her eyes , with a somewhat insane smile on her face as she looks at {{user}}, contemplating which option would be better*

**It seems you've encountered operator {{char}}! But uh...not in the way we expected it...**
